calibration_blind_spot_caveat: Flagged from very few measurements. Treat this as a question, not a finding.
calibration_blind_spot_no_data: Nothing is measured yet, so nothing can be flagged.
calibration_blind_spot_none: No topic is flagged as a blind spot.
calibration_empty_body: Predict how well a session will go before it starts and measure it afterwards; both halves appear here.
calibration_interpretation: Each row is one topic: the confidence you predicted above the score you measured. Nothing is averaged and no trend is fitted — with a handful of ratings either would read as a verdict this data cannot support.
calibration_legacy_excluded: {count} topics were scored by the retired scorer, which recorded a perfect result for anything submitted. Those are not measurements.
calibration_reading_sparse: Based on {count} measured topics, which is too few to read a pattern from.
calibration_summary: How the confidence you commit to compares with the score you go on to measure.
calibration_unmeasured: {count} topics carry a prediction but no measurement yet.
chronos_complete_failed: That could not be marked complete. Nothing changed.
chronos_effort_caption: Average error per kind of work
chronos_effort_empty: No estimation accuracy yet. It appears once a deadline with an estimate has been reflected on.
chronos_effort_sparse: {count} of these rest on fewer than three finished deadlines. Read them as a hint, not a measurement.
chronos_effort_summary: {count} kinds of work, each showing how far your hour estimates were out on average.
chronos_empty_body: Sync to import the assignments, quizzes and exams from your connected course.
chronos_history_capped: Only the most recent {limit} past deadlines are shown.
chronos_history_empty_body: A deadline appears here once its date has passed.
chronos_history_late_unavailable: “Late” cannot appear here: the history records whether a deadline was reflected on, never when it was finished.
chronos_history_no_matches_body: Clear the filter to see the whole history.
chronos_history_summary: What has already been due, and how close your effort estimates came.
chronos_summary: What is coming up, how far away it is, and how much of it you have already tracked.
chronos_sync_failed: The sync did not finish. Nothing was changed.
chronos_sync_none: The sync found no deadlines. Check the connection in settings.
chronos_workload_empty: No workload figure yet. It appears once a deadline carries an estimate.
content_catalog_truncated: {count} further sources are not shown here. Narrow the course selection to reach them.
content_empty_body: Nothing has been uploaded or synced for this course. Adding a source is what fills this page.
content_language_from_default: No course language is set, so the default applies.
content_language_from_learning_path: This is the language the course is examined in.
content_language_from_override: You chose this content language for this visit.
content_no_matches_body: Every lecture is filtered out. Clearing the filters brings the catalogue back.
content_sources_discover_failed: The scan did not complete. Nothing was changed.
content_sources_empty_body: Sources appear here once a scan finds them or an upload is accepted.
content_sources_summary: Upload a recording or a reading, or re-scan the systems this course is connected to.
content_summary: Every lecture Sophia has picked up, and how far each one has got through downloading, transcription and indexing.
content_upload_body: The file is checked and queued for processing. You can leave the page once it has been accepted.
content_upload_error_failed: The upload did not go through. Nothing was stored.
content_upload_error_mismatch: That file's contents do not match its extension, so it was not accepted.
content_upload_error_title_too_long: That title is too long. Keep it under 200 characters.
content_upload_error_too_large: That file is over the {megabytes} MB limit.
content_upload_error_unsupported: That file type is not accepted. Accepted: {formats}.
content_upload_state_queued: It is queued for transcription and indexing, which runs in the background. The catalogue shows its progress.
dashboard_calibration_empty_body: Predict a topic before studying it, then finish the session. The gap between the two is what this panel is for.
dashboard_calibration_figure_summary: {count} topics, each showing the confidence you committed to above the score you went on to get.
dashboard_calibration_legacy_excluded: {count} topics are left out: their score comes from the retired scorer and is not a measurement.
dashboard_calibration_unmeasured: {count} topics are predicted but not measured yet.
dashboard_due_empty_body: Nothing has fallen due. A session started now becomes a review later.
dashboard_next_action_quickstart: Nothing has been set up yet. Quickstart names your topics and takes your first predictions.
dashboard_next_action_resume: You left a session on {topic} unfinished. Its comparison needs the second half.
dashboard_next_action_review: {count} reviews are due. They are worth less every day they wait.
dashboard_next_action_study: Nothing is due. Start a session on whatever feels least settled.
dashboard_no_learning_path: This workspace has no numeric learning path selected, so nothing here can be scoped to it yet.
dashboard_panel_error: This part did not answer. The rest of the page is current.
dashboard_panel_unauthorized: This part is outside what your account may read.
dashboard_pressure_caption: Reviews falling due over the next week
dashboard_pressure_empty_body: No reviews fall due this week. The schedule fills up as you finish sessions.
dashboard_pressure_summary: {count} reviews fall due over the next seven days.
dashboard_sessions_empty_body: Sessions you start appear here, finished or not.
dashboard_summary: A compact operations view for review pressure, course context, and study readiness.
home_summary: A quiet shell for the authenticated Sophia application, ready for future API-backed routes.
login_error_invalid_credentials: The account or password did not match.
login_summary: Use your TU Wien credentials to open the Sophia workspace.
quickstart_done_body: Your topics are saved and your first predictions are on record. From here, studying is what turns them into a comparison.
quickstart_done_suggestion: Start with {topic} — it is the first thing you named.
quickstart_predict_body: Commit to how well you know each one before you study it. The prediction is half of what the dashboard later compares.
quickstart_predict_empty: There is nothing to rate yet.
quickstart_predict_legend: How well do you know {topic} right now?
quickstart_ratings_required: Rate at least one topic before continuing.
quickstart_save_failed: That could not be saved. Try again shortly.
quickstart_summary: Four steps to name what you are studying and take your first predictions. Nothing here is graded.
quickstart_topics_body: Name the topics you expect this course to cover. Rough guesses are worth more than none: the act of guessing is what pulls up what you already know.
quickstart_topics_empty: Nothing has been synced yet, so start from your own list.
quickstart_topics_required: Write at least one topic, or skip this step.
quickstart_welcome_act: Work: answer from memory before you look anything up.
quickstart_welcome_body: Sophia is built around one loop. It is worth knowing what it asks of you before you start.
quickstart_welcome_predict: Predict: say how well you know a topic, before studying it.
quickstart_welcome_reflect: Reflect: see the prediction against what happened.
register_detail_error: TISS did not answer for this course. Nothing here is current.
register_error_course_number: That is not a TISS course number. One looks like 123.ABC.
register_error_session: Your TISS session is no longer valid. Sign in again in settings.
register_error_unavailable: TISS could not be reached. Nothing was registered.
register_favorites_empty_body: Mark a course as a favourite in TISS and it appears here.
register_no_exams: No exam dates were reported for this course.
register_no_groups: No groups were reported for this course.
register_no_open_groups: No group is open for registration right now.
register_session_expired_body: Sign in to TISS again in settings, then come back.
register_session_missing_body: Connect your TISS account in settings; this page reads your favourites through it.
register_summary: Your TISS favourites, the groups still open, and the window each registration falls in.
review_empty_body: Nothing is due right now. Reviews appear here as the schedule brings topics back.
review_finished_body: {count} topics reviewed. The next dates are set.
review_grade_rejected: That review was not saved and the topic came back. Retry when you are ready.
review_prompt: Recall what you know about this topic, then check yourself.
review_recall_hint: Write it out before revealing. Retrieving it is what makes it stick.
review_summary: Topics the schedule has brought back. Scores and next dates come from the server; nothing here decides them.
search_no_sources_body: Add a content source and let it finish processing; search reads what has been indexed.
search_prompt_assumptions: What assumptions does this explanation rely on? Which might break?
search_prompt_connect: How does this passage relate to what you studied before?
search_prompt_example: Give a concrete example where this concept applies.
search_prompt_explain: In your own words, what did this passage explain?
search_prompt_list: List the three key definitions in this passage.
search_prompt_question: Write a question about this passage that would test deep understanding.
search_retrieval_hint: Answering from memory is the part that sticks. Nothing you write here is sent anywhere.
search_status_error: The search did not answer. Try again in a moment.
search_status_idle: Type at least two characters to search.
search_summary: Find the passage in your course material that answers a question, then write something from it before you move on.
settings_summary: Adjust display and language preferences for the current session.
study_act_summary: Write your answer, reveal, and rate how it went. Keyboard: space reveals, 1 to 4 grade.
study_band_overconfident: You knew this less well than you expected. That gap is the most useful thing on this page.
study_band_underconfident: You knew this better than you expected. Underrating yourself costs study time you did not need to spend.
study_band_unknown: Not enough answered yet to compare.
study_band_well_calibrated: Your prediction matched what happened. Trust that judgement next time.
study_dwell_blocked: Stay with the prompt a moment longer before revealing.
study_extend_failed: More cards could not be generated.
study_grade_rejected: That grade was not saved and the card came back. Retry when you are ready.
study_keyboard_note: Shortcuts are ignored while you are typing an answer. Every one has a button as well.
study_legacy_scored: This session carries a score from the old heuristic and is not comparable.
study_not_available: The study API did not answer. Try again shortly.
study_path_empty_body: Nothing has been synced from TUWEL for your account yet. Sync your courses, then come back here to choose one.
study_path_select_failed: That course could not be selected. Try again.
study_path_summary: Sessions and reviews belong to one course at a time. Switching later keeps what you did in the others.
study_path_unavailable: Your courses could not be loaded from TUWEL just now. Reload the page to try again.
study_posttest_hint: Same question as before. Answer it again from memory.
study_predict_legend: How well do you know {topic} right now?
study_predict_required: Record a prediction and a pre-test answer before studying.
study_predict_summary: Commit to how well you think you know this topic, then answer one question before studying. Both are needed later to tell you what actually changed.
study_pretest_hint: Answer from memory. A wrong answer here is what makes the comparison at the end worth anything.
study_queue_empty: No cards left in this session.
study_reflect_summary: Answer the same question again, then take a moment before the numbers.
study_reflection_countdown: The results open in {seconds} seconds. Use them to write, not to wait.
study_reflection_prompt: Which part still feels unfinished, and why?
study_reflection_required: Write a reflection before opening the results.
study_reflection_too_soon: The reflection pause has not finished yet. Give it another moment.
study_reveal_blocked: {remaining} more characters of your own answer before you can reveal.
study_session_start_failed: The session could not be started.
study_sessions_empty: No sessions yet. Start one above.
study_summary: Predict, work, and reflect in one equilibration cycle. Scores come from the server; nothing here grades you on whether you typed something.
study_undo_already_committed: That grade is already saved, so it cannot be taken back.
topics_empty_body: Topics come from your lecture transcripts, or from naming them yourself in quickstart.
topics_no_matches_body: Every topic is filtered out. Clearing the filters brings the list back.
topics_summary: What this course covers, where each topic came from, and how confident you said you were.
